test_title: PYST 42 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate preposition:**

The delegates conferred ____ the issue for several hours before reaching consensus.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**on**" is used when discussing topics, subjects, or issues.
 
• In the given sentence, "on the issue" correctly conveys that the delegates were deliberating about the issue.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 4 are inc
